LOCAL WATCHLIST CACHE: matching happens at the EDGE
Synced out every few minutes · tens of MB · matching survives a central /
WAN outage. Match logic: exact → OCR-ambiguity map (O↔0, I↔1, S↔5, B↔8, Z↔2,
G↔6) → Levenshtein ≤ 1 for reads ≥ 8 characters. Shorter reads are route
candidates only and never fire an alert.
